releaseNotes:
✨ What's new in v2.7:
• 💳 Payment App Detection: Intercepts custom UPI schemes (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm) and alerts if an app is not installed, preventing crashes.
• 💾 Canvas High-Quality Export Fix: Fully resolves connection label background and node card background black box rendering in exported images.
• 📁 Native Downloads Support: Seamlessly intercepts and saves exported canvas PNG/JPG/PDF formats directly into device Downloads folder natively.
